description: Election Commission -  Declare that K. H. J. Krishantha as member of the Beliattha P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Beliatta Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy created by death, which falls under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters and candidate nominations/declarations at the local government level.
